title: Juicy Winey Croatian Pasta Pasta
description: A rich and comforting dish featuring sesame butter, pasta-water emulsion, and a hint of Croatian flair, perfect for a sick day.
instructions: Cook spaghetti in boiling salted water until al dente.
In a large saucepan, combine sesame butter and white wine over medium heat, whisking until smooth.
Add chicken broth, heavy cream, and grated ginger to the saucepan, whisking until smooth.
Bring saucepan mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in parmesan cheese until melted.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs and a pinch of salt until well combined.
Add cooked spaghetti to the bowl with eggs and toss until coated.
Add saucepan mixture to the bowl with spaghetti and eggs, tossing until well combined.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
If desired, add additional grated ginger or parmesan cheese on top of each serving.
